senses.gloss: रोप 1.
रोप &c. See p. 889, cols. 1, 2.
1. रोप m. (√ 1. रुप्) confusing, disturbing, W.
2. रोप m. (fr. Caus. of √ 1. रुह्) the act of raising, setting up, planting, fixing in &c., MBh.
an arrow, Śiś.; Naiṣ.
रोप n. a fissure, hole.
रोपण &c. See p. 889, col. 2.
1. रोपण॑ mfn. causing bodily pain, AV.
रोपण॑ n. = विमोहन or उपद्रव, TBr., Sch.
2. रोपण mf(ई)n. causing to grow, causing to grow over or cicatrize, healing, Suśr.
putting on Kathās.
रोपण m. an arrow, L.
रोपण n. the act of setting up or erecting, raising, Kṛṣis.
the act of planting, setting, sowing, transplanting, Pañcat.; Kṛṣis.
healing or a healing application (used for sores), Suśr.
रोपयिष्णु mfn. rending, tearing, lacerating, Vait.
रो॑पि f. acute or racking pain, AV.
1. रोपित mfn. bewildered, perplexed, W.
2. रोपित mfn. caused to grow, raised, elevated &c.
fixed, directed, aimed (as an arrow), Ragh.; Sāh.
set (as a jewel), Hit.
committed, entrusted, Ragh.
set, planted, Kull. on Mn. i, 46.
रो॑पुषी f. (prob.) female destroyer, RV. i, 191, 13 (Sāy.)
रोपक m. a planter (see वृक्ष-र्˚)
a weight of metal or a coin (1/10 of a Suvarṇa), W. (cf. रूपक).
रोपणीय mfn. to be set up or erected or raised, Kṛṣis.
to be planted or sown, VarBṛS.
useful for healing or cicatrizing, Suśr.
रोपयितृ mfn. one who sets up or erects, an erecter (with acc. or gen.), R.
a planter, Kull. on Mn. iii, 163.
रोपिन् mf(इणी)n. (ifc.) raising, erecting, setting planting, MBh.; Kull.
रोप्य mfn. to be planted or sown or transplanted, MBh.; Suśr.
रोपणा॑का f. a kind of bird, RV.; AV. (Sāy. ‘a thrush’ = शारिका).
